choose.otherwise: and ( sm.survey_title_snapshot like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or sm.submitter_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.insert: insert into sa_survey_submit_mst (survey_seq, survey_uid, submit_uid, survey_title_snapshot, submitter_name, phone, email, status, submitted_dtm, ip, reg_dtm, reg_id, mod_dtm, mod_id) values (#{surveySeq}, #{surveyUid}, #{submitUid}, #{surveyTitle}, #{submitterName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{status}, now(), #{ip}, now(), 'system', now(), 'system')

insert into sa_survey_answer_dtl (submit_seq, field_seq, field_key_snapshot, field_label_snapshot, field_type_snapshot, required_yn_snapshot, answer_value, answer_json, sort_ord, reg_dtm, reg_id, mod_dtm, mod_id) values (#{submitSeq}, #{fieldSeq}, #{fieldKey}, #{fieldLabel}, #{fieldType}, 'N', #{answerValue}, #{answerJson}, #{sortOrd}, now(), 'system', now(), 'system')
mapper.select:
select row_number() over (order by sm.submitted_dtm desc, sm.submit_seq desc) as row_no, sm.submit_seq, sm.submit_uid, sm.survey_uid, sm.survey_title_snapshot as survey_title, sm.submitter_name, sm.phone, sm.status, date(sm.submitted_dtm) as submitted_date from sa_survey_submit_mst sm
order by sm.submitted_dtm desc, sm.submit_seq desc

select submit_seq, submit_uid, survey_uid, survey_title_snapshot as survey_title, submitter_name, phone, email, status, admin_memo, date(submitted_dtm) as submitted_date from sa_survey_submit_mst where submit_uid = #{submitUid}

select answer_seq, submit_seq, field_key_snapshot as field_key, field_label_snapshot as field_label, field_type_snapshot as field_type, answer_value, answer_json, sort_ord from sa_survey_answer_dtl where submit_seq = #{submitSeq} order by sort_ord, answer_seq
mapper.update: update sa_survey_submit_mst set status = #{status}, admin_memo = #{adminMemo}, mod_dtm = now(), mod_id = 'system' where submit_uid = #{submitUid}
mapper.select:
select sm.submit_uid, sm.survey_title_snapshot as survey_title, sm.submitter_name, sm.phone, sm.email, sm.status, date(sm.submitted_dtm) as submitted_date, a.field_label_snapshot as field_label, a.answer_value, a.answer_json, a.sort_ord from sa_survey_submit_mst sm left join sa_survey_answer_dtl a on a.submit_seq = sm.submit_seq
order by sm.submitted_dtm desc, sm.submit_seq desc, a.sort_ord, a.answer_seq

select s.status, coalesce(counts.cnt, 0) as cnt from ( select 'new' as status, 1 as ord union all select 'reviewing', 2 union all select 'contacted', 3 union all select 'done', 4 union all select 'hold', 5 ) s left join ( select status, count(*) as cnt from sa_survey_submit_mst where survey_seq = #{surveySeq} group by status ) counts on counts.status = s.status order by s.ord

with recursive date_spine as ( select date(now()) - interval 59 day as d union all select d + interval 1 day from date_spine where d < date(now()) ) select date_format(ds.d, '%Y-%m-%d') as submitted_date, coalesce(counts.cnt, 0) as cnt from date_spine ds left join ( select date(submitted_dtm) as day, count(*) as cnt from sa_survey_submit_mst where survey_seq = #{surveySeq} and date(submitted_dtm) >= date(now()) - interval 59 day group by date(submitted_dtm) ) counts on counts.day = ds.d order by ds.d

select o.option_label, count(a.answer_seq) as cnt from sa_survey_field_opt_dtl o left join sa_survey_answer_dtl a on a.field_seq = o.field_seq and a.answer_value = o.option_label and a.submit_seq in ( select submit_seq from sa_survey_submit_mst where survey_seq = #{surveySeq} ) where o.field_seq = #{fieldSeq} group by o.option_label, o.sort_ord order by o.sort_ord, o.field_opt_seq

select a.answer_value from sa_survey_answer_dtl a join sa_survey_submit_mst sm on sm.submit_seq = a.submit_seq where sm.survey_seq = #{surveySeq} and a.field_seq = #{fieldSeq} and a.answer_value is not null and a.answer_value != '' order by sm.submitted_dtm desc, a.answer_seq desc limit 20
